We’re hiring a Talent Manager (Creators & Content) at Baton Corporation, the development company behind Pumpfun.

We’re working with some of the biggest creators on the internet, and many of them have never traded onchain before. The faster they find their footing on the Pumpfun app, the faster their audiences follow, and we need someone to own that relationship.

You’ll be the day-to-day partner for every creator we work with: building trust, developing content ideas with them, coordinating what goes live and when, and finding the next creators worth working with.

What you need:

• Experience working directly with creators and/or streamers (Kick, Twitch, YouTube, TikTok, X)
• Strong content instincts and a feel for what makes an audience engage
• Based in NYC (or willing & able to relocate), and happy to travel regularly (we’ll fund all expenses)

You don’t need crypto experience. You need to understand creators.

$200k–$400k + tokens & benefits.

Apply below
